IMG_7552.note: Tape measured bolt to bolt (pairs) and along the wall surface (edges). Points are normalized x, y on the EXIF-upright photo, read by eye from the drawn lines (about +-1% of the photo, so +-3 cm on a pair); not yet pixel-exact.

epic_wall.note: Different gym wall, 10 panels (angles 14-31 deg, see measurements.md). Pair points are the centres of the green number labels drawn on the photo (2420x3294, EXIF-upright), converted to normalized x, y; the checker snaps each to the nearest detected hold. Pairs 1, 4, 5 were measured bolt to bolt; pair 3 hand to hand (the endpoints are where a hand goes, not a bolt, so expect a few cm of extra difference). Pairs 2 and 6 and the 322 cm vertical line were deleted as measurement errors (human, 2026-11-13); the numbering keeps the original labels. 'edges' is the top green line drawn on the photo, endpoints fitted to its pixels (exact), measured along the wall surface. Bolt hole spacing: 25 cm per grid square (human, 2026-11-13; first read as 26 cm from '5 holes across a row = 1.04 m').

epic_wall_2.note: Same photo and wall as epic_wall (pixel-identical under the drawings; same gym, holds and panel angles). Bolt spacing 25 cm (human, 2026-11-13; supersedes the 26 cm read from '5 bolts across = 1.04 m'). Re-measured with a real tape measure (2026-11-13; raw notes in epic_wall_2_measured.txt). Pairs are labelled on the photo by small red digits 3-6 (the black 1 and 2 were deleted as measurement errors, human 2026-11-13: about 30-40% longer than the bolt grid and the earlier measurements of the same holds). Pairs 3-6 are bolt to bolt, and their points are the bolt hole beside each label (EXIF-upright, normalized), checked by eye on crops, about +-10 px; holds stand off the wall, so a bolt on a hold sits a few cm in front of the wall. 'snap': false = both ends are bare wall bolt holes, so the checker measures the points as given instead of snapping to a hold. The red vertical line (457 cm) is drawn on the photo; its endpoints are fitted to its pixels (diff against the undrawn copy). The horizontal line (301 cm) is left out (the human was unsure of it).
